review: A single reviewer screened all 194 rendered candidate windows. This allow-list removes repeated viewpoints and questionable vehicle, sign and rider boundaries. Original KITTI instances are used for people and vehicles; isolated sign and light components derive from native semantic regions. Per-ring raster IoU is checked by the converter. A second check against frozen evaluation frames follows before packaging.

examples.7-12,43-53: Many frames repeat the same junction. Retained different traffic participants or a materially different window.
examples.136,138,140: Stacked direction signs look connected and are not reliable individual instances.
examples.94,96,98: Repeated scene with vans; difficult to distinguish cargo variants under competition rules.
examples.159,160: Minimal target evidence at window boundary.
